verdict.rationale: Stripe documents API equivalents for core Billing workflows: subscriptions can be created "in the Dashboard or with the Subscriptions API", and there are a Trial Offer API, a Meters API, an official OpenAPI spec, a CLI and an MCP server. However, no evidence states full API/UI parity, and several flows (customer portal activation and branding, the no-code migration toolkit, no-code invoice creation) are documented only as Dashboard actions. missing for 10: an explicit statement or demonstration of API parity with the Dashboard, documented API paths for portal configuration, migration and analytics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Create a new subscription in the Dashboard or with the Subscriptions API.
Use the Trial Offer API to manage both free and paid introductory periods for your subscriptions with a single API integration.
Let your AI agents interact with the Stripe API by using our MCP server.
This repository contains OpenAPI specifications for Stripe's API
